title: AI film
summary: A film made of shots generated by image and video models (short story, mood film, music film), directed shot by shot from approved key frames within an authorised budget.

notFor.when: an ad or film for a product or app, even with generated shots (ai-video as its secondary type)
an animated film of type, shapes, logos or collage built in code, not generated footage
a cut-to-music film from stock or supplied b-roll
a generated presenter, avatar or talking photo speaks to camera
a teaser or trailer that builds to a reveal or a date, even with generated shots

qa: No video item was funded before its key frame was approved (a second material approval)
Cuts land on action or a sound; no shot is held into a morph, drift or slow-motion tail
Music and ambience run across cuts; clip audio is kept only where the shot owns it, never two voices
No real person's likeness without recorded consent, and no artist, film or brand named in a prompt
The platform AI label for each target platform is listed for the user's upload

intake.ask: What ceiling in USD may generation spend on this film, and how many paid attempts per shot?
intake.why: Every shot is a paid job; without an authorised bound nothing is generated (budget --ceiling-usd --answer "<the user's words>" --attempts)

intake.ask: Is there a script, treatment or song, or shall I write the story at the script step?
intake.why: The beat sheet and every shot spec follow the story or the track's sections
intake.default: the story is written at the script step

intake.ask: Do recurring characters appear, and is any of them a real person whose likeness we may use (with recorded consent)?
intake.why: Each needs an entity card before any shot; a real likeness needs likenessConsent
intake.default: invented characters only, no real likeness

intake.why: Realistic generated scenes need the YouTube, TikTok and Meta AI labels; stylised animation is exempt on YouTube

intake.ask: Does anyone speak on screen, or does music and ambience carry it?
intake.why: Dialogue switches native audio on for those shots and needs captions; otherwise native audio stays off
Sets the formats, the length band and the AI label list handed over with the film
intake.default: YouTube landscape plus one vertical cut for Reels and Shorts

profiles.note: Realistic AI content is disclosed at upload (altered or synthetic content); clearly animated work is exempt. Dialogue films ship an SRT rather than burned captions
Square or vertical up to 3 min counts as a Short; the same AI disclosure applies. Band is a house rule for a cut-down
Meta labels photorealistic AI video; disclose at upload. Reels over 3 min are not recommended to new audiences
Realistic AI scenes or people must carry TikTok's AI-generated label or may be removed; 9:16 recommended

starter.note: One shared film-finish grain over every generated shot ties mixed generations together; whip-pan and light-burn hide joins only when the music motivates them; titles are set as type over picture, never generated. No library style: the look comes from the key frames

variants.title: AI music video
variants.changes: The track is supplied and its sections are the beat sheet (audio:map); cuts on downbeats; no generated lip sync of sung lines unless the user accepts its look; the artist's likeness only with recorded consent; length is the track, landscape first, a vertical hook cut second

variants.title: AI mood film
variants.changes: No story and no recurring character: entity cards only for the style and locations; text-to-video allowed for more shots since there is little continuity to keep; 15-60 s; one colour treatment and one music bed carry it; spares go to variety of texture, not coverage
